description: This Java interface defines a mapper using MapStruct for converting SearchedExternalAssetOwner objects into ExternalTransferData objects. It specifies mapping strategies, including custom conversions for fields like owner, loan, transfer external ID, status, sub-status, and details, with some methods marked as @Named for reusability.

classes.name: ExternalAssetOwnerSearchDataMapper
classes.description: Mapper interface for converting SearchedExternalAssetOwner to ExternalTransferData, with custom field mappings.

methods.name: map
methods.description: Main mapping method converting SearchedExternalAssetOwner to ExternalTransferData with specified field mappings.

methods.name: toTransferExternalId
methods.description: Converts source to its transfer external ID string.

methods.name: toLoanExternalId
methods.description: Creates ExternalTransferLoanData from source loan details.

methods.name: toOwner
methods.description: Creates ExternalTransferOwnerData from source owner information.

methods.name: toDetails
methods.description: Builds ExternalTransferDataDetails from source details, if present.
